name: Agatsuma Hiroki
source:
A young man who stands in the position of founder and representative of "Azuma Real Estate Agents". As a boy he was raised in the city, so Hiroki is less confident in his physical strength than the village residents. It is clear Hiroki is more used to working using his head, rather than his body's strength. Therefore moving to a village can become somewhat difficult to him.

[Translated from Getchu]
